_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); home-improvement retail signals

classification.quality_note: Lowe's: the world's second largest home improvement retailer, 1,840 home improvement and hardware stores in the U.S., Canada and Mexico with approximately 201 million square feet, serving do-it-yourself, do-it-for-me and professional customers; its sales follow housing turnover and the activity level of home improvement projects (its own 10-K), the franchise does not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 2.77x; +72% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.53; conservative 2yr +9%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -19.9%/yr (worst year FY05-FY14, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +19.8%/yr (FY15 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +19.8%/yr (FY05-FY14 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +26.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY05-FY14); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: LOW (retrospective, 2015-10-09) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 2.77x (59.1% downside to Bear $30 / +21.4% upside to Bull $89) | Adj composite 1.74 vs market 3.27: gap -1.53 [OVERVALUED] | +71% above the EPP floor $43 (13x FY15E $3.29) | Conservative 2-yr case: +9.0% total (+4.5%/yr) | At 22.3x FY15E the 15% hurdle price $97 sits above the BULL case; comps +4.3% in Q2 FY15, forward sales +4.5-5% (FY15 sales guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
